Commentary.Commentary: Thus, that is all from the Sharjah leg in this 5-match ODI series. The two teams now head to Sheikh Zayed Stadium, Abu Dhabi for the 3rd ODI which will be on the 27th of March, Wednesday. That game will begin at 1500 local (1100 GMT). Make sure you join for that one to find out whether Pakistan can keep the series alive or not. Till then, take care and cheers. Goodbye!

Aaron Finch, the Man of the match and the Aussie skipper says that it was important for set batsmen to continue batting once they were in. He informs that he did not want to take a risk against Imad Wasim and looked to play him out. Praises Usman Khawaja and says he is very happy for him as he is scoring big runs. Reckons that it is a learning curve for all the players with a big few months coming up. Exits by mentioning that Jhye Richardson is in good spirits and it is an unfortunate shoulder dislocation. Hopes he will be fit soon.

Shoaib Malik says that they needed early strikes. He looks at the positive of taking the game till the end. Feels that youngsters are being groomed and such matches will happen as they are testing the bench strength. Praises Mohammad Rizwan for scoring runs against a big team and mentions he is a special talent. Considers that such things happen in cricket when you try different stuff with your team combination. Does not forget to applaud Aaron Finch for his magnificent 150 and says it is difficult to win when an opener scores so many in a chase of 280-odd. Signs off by saying that the goal is not about winning the series or anything but to give the bench strength a test and to give opportunity to everyone to play.

Usman Khawaja says that the partnership with Aaron Finch was great. He said that he tried to keep it aggresive in the beginning when his partner was struggling a bit. Applauds Finch for an amazing knock of more than 150. He mentions that he has always been strong off his wrists. Informs us that he is happy as is his side to win against a strong side like Pakistan. States that he enjoys playing at this ground and coming from Indian conditions, has helped him adjust.

Earlier in the evening, it was the hosts who won the toss and elected to bat. They did recover well after being 4 down before the halfway mark but they could not post a par-300 total in the end that was required. Rizwan got his maiden ODI ton as well but that was never going to be enough on this Sharjah surface which became better for batting in the end. Stay tuned for the presentations but before that Usman Khawaja with an interview on the sidelines.

Coming to the bowling, it was looking flat and fell on their face against the willows of Aaron Finch and Usman Khawaja. They seemed to run out of ideas and no one even looked like picking a wicket, barring Md. Hasnain for a few overs. Shoaib Malik and co. will have to seriously go back and have a look at their bowling combination if they are to make a comeback in this series.

This has been one stroll in the park! The Aussies have batted with ease and grace, winning the match comfortably by 8 wickets and more than 2 overs left in the end. It was a risk-free run chase and belonged to one man especially. The skipper, Aaron Finch made his 13th ODI ton and finished off with a massive 153 not out in the end. It included 6 sixes as well. The 209-run opening stand meant there was only going to be one winner. In fact, only 2 wickets were lost and one was a run out. The bowlers felt a little helpless.

Leg Byes! That is it! Two runs taken but it does not matter how they come! On a length, Finch goes for the flick but misses and the ball hits his pads and goes through square leg for the winning runs.  AUSTRALIA WIN BY 8 WICKETS!! Once more! And take a 2-0 lead in the series.
On a length outside off, Marsh pats it down near the surface for a single. Only two needed now.
On a length and patted down to long on for a single by the Aussie skipper.

FOUR! Yes, he can! This is getting over soon! On the hips and Finch turns it away through deep backward square leg for a boundary. Gets to his 150 as well! Stand up and applaud this guy wherever you are. This has been a classic!

SIX! That has completely killed any hopes that Pakistan might have had left in the game. A fuller length ball from Faheem on middle and Finch smashes it right back over his head for a maximum. 148 now!

Another run out chance missed here by the fielder! Finch goes back on this length ball and punches it covers and takes off. He was quick to start the run but was nowhere close to the crease when the throw went past the non striker's stumps. Had he hit, Finch would have been out but it is way too late for them to get him out. He has already done the job for his side and has survived this run out chance as well. Would like to finish unbeaten at the end of the innings and with a 150 for himself. Can he get there?
Full and outside off, Marsh drives it superbly through the covers for a single.
Fuller this time on middle, Finch punches it down the ground for a single.
SIX! OUT OF THE PARK! Another short ball this time to Finch who gets it off the meat of the bat and sends it sailing over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. That makes the equation a lot easier now.
Short ball to Marsh, he pulls it hard to short mid-wicket and takes a quick run.
Thats a beauty from Hasnain! He bowls a yorker to Finch who gets his bat down at the right time and the ball takes the inside half of the bat and goes fine on the on side for a single.
Driven through mid on for a single. 5 runs off this over. 25 in 24 needed now.
Just short! Well saved by Yasir in the deep. A length ball on middle and Shah at deep mid-wicket comes running in to take that catch. He does not reach the ball and stops it at 2 runs.

In the air... and safe! A length ball, Marsh looks to pull it. The ball hits the shoulder off the bat and goes up in the air. Falls near the vacant mid on region.Very lucky from Australia's point of view. A wicket would have been some panic for them.
Good bowling! Only 1 run off the 3 balls so far. A length ball outside off, Marsh looks to pull but fails to time it at all.
Hit slightly in the air towards mid-wicket and a quick single is taken. The pitch is becoming really slow here, this ball stuck in it and came.
On a length and top of middle, Finch only manages to push it towards mid-wicket.

Would have been out had he hit! Marsh punches this length ball off the back foot to the point region and takes off for a single but Finch shouts a loud NO bacause the fielder was onto the ball very quickly. The fielder has a shy at the sticks but misses. Marsh was a goner if the throw was accurate because he was way down the track. 30 runs needed off 30 balls.
Full ball outside off, Finch rocks back and punches it to covers for a single.
BEATEN! Finch tries to drive this length ball on the up but gets beaten due to the pace of the ball.
LEG BYE! Bowls it on the pads this time, Marsh goes for the flick but misses and the ball rolls fine off his pads. One run taken.
EXCELLENT FIELDING! Fuller ball outside off, Marsh punches it off the back foot through the point region. Shan Masood in the deep makes a diving effort and saves two runs for his side.
Slower ball outside off, Marsh tries to defend it but the ball shapes away and goes past his outside edge.
Mohammad Hasnain is back into the attack.
On a length and top of middle stump, defended back towards the bowler by the Australia skipper. Just 2 off this over, 34 runs now needed in 36 balls.
Patted on the off side for a single on the front foot by SOS.
Good fielding! A short length ball outside off, Marsh pulls it hard but Sohail at mid-wicket makes a tumbling stop to his left. Prevents any runs.
Short of a length outside off, Marsh stands tall and adjusts in the end to defend that ball towards cover.
Flicked away wristily by AF for a single to deep mid-wicket.
On a length and played away to point off the back foot by Finch.
Floated delivery on middle, Finch rocks back and punches it down to long off for a run.
Flighted ball on middle, Marsh punches it off the back foot to mid off for a single.
Shah bowls it shorter this time, Marsh dances down the track and drives it superbly through covers for a double.
Another full ball on middle and leg, Marsh flicks it to square leg.
Tossed up on off, Marsh drives it mid on.

BYES! MISSES EVERYONE! Yasir bowls a leg cutter from round the wicket, the ball turns back in sharply and misses Shaun's drive and even misses the keepers' gloves. The fielder at fine leg cuts it off. Brace completed.
Guided down to third man by the southpaw as he gets off the mark. 42 runs needed in 48 balls now.
Another defensive shot on the back foot by Shaun Marsh to this ball on a length and on middle stump line.
On a length and defended towards mid-wicket by the new batsman.
On a length and it is pushed off the back foot to deep cover for a single.
Shaun Marsh is in next at number 4.

RUN OUT! Maxwell has to depart from here after some hard hitting. He is unlucky here as he just replied to his skipper's call. Finch nudges this short ball off his back foot to the leg side. Haris Sohail at backward square leg comes running in and gathers the ball quickly and hits the bull's eye. Maxwell was way short there. He knew it and straightaway started walking.
Run out appeal! Haris Sohail with a direct hit at the bowler's end and Maxwell is walking back without waiting for the replays. Looks like even he knows he was out of the crease.
Full ball on off, Maxwell gets an inside on this one and the ball goes to short fine leg for a single.
Faheem Ashraf is back on.
Inside edge on to the leg side off the flatter one on middle. A run is taken. 45 runs needed in the last nine overs.
Aaron has punched the ball off the back foot back to the bowler.
Finch pulls away... seems to have been distracted by the napkin falling from Yasir Shah's trousers.
Cut away to deep point for a single by Glenn Maxwell.
Slower through the air this time, defended off the back foot by the batsman from the crease.
Hurled in quick on the pads, pushed to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs by Maxwell.
Flatter one on middle, played away to deep square leg for a single by Finch.
Powerplay 3 time. 5 fielders can be kept outside the circle now till the end. 5 is the required run rate.

SIX! HIGH AND INTO THE STANDS! When Maxwell hits them off the middle, there is only one way where the ball goes and it's into the stands. Makes room on this one and lofts it straight with sheer power. The ball goes high and into the top stand at long on. 15 off the over. 50 runs needed off 60 balls.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Another flat batted heave this time but it falls just short of the long on fielder. One run taken.
SIX! MIGHTY! Maxwell reads the line of this ball early and heaves it high and over the long on fence for a maximum.
Wide! Strays down the leg and the ball goes down. Wide signaled.
Tossed up on off, driven through the covers.
Full ball on middle, Maxwell gets an inside through his legs on the leg side. The keeper collects it quickly.
FOUR! Flatter outside off and Finch goes through with the shot. He smashes it right back past the bowler. No chance for the long off fielder. 65 needed in 66 balls now.
Good ball once more! Flatter and quicker on middle, on the money and Finch just pushes it back to the bowler.
Good ball outside off, pushed back towards the bowler to his left.
Single taken again. This time off the bat off Maxwell as he sweeps this to fine leg.
Quicker and flatter on the middle, worked away to deep square leg for a run by Aaron.
Flatter ball on middle, swept to short fine leg by Finch.
Another floated ball on middle, Finch goes back and punches it to cover-point for a single.
Floated on leg, Maxwell punches it off the back foot to the on side for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Maxwell drives it but straight to the fielder at cover.
Arm ball this one coming in to the right hander, Finch makes room and punches it to covers for a single.
Floated on off, Maxi is off the mark with a single down to long off.
Tossed up outside off, Finch drives it mid off for a single.
Imad Wasim to bowl now.
Another dot to end the over. A maiden wicket over!
A flighted ball on middle, defended back down to the bowler.
Glenn Maxwell is out to bat next.

OUT! The pressure tells and finally a wicket for Pakistan! Khawaja holes out in the deep. No hundred for him. A flatter ball outside off, Usman goes for a slog sweep but finds deep mid-wicket. Imam there makes no mistake. The mammoth 209-run stand is broken! Can this be the opening Pakistan want? It seems a little too late though. 76 runs required in 80 balls now.
The batsman has driven it through mid-on. Three dots in a row. Some kind of pressure building.
Bowls it on the pads, flicked away to the mid-wicket region.
Googly to begin with. Pitches it on a length, the ball grips and bounces than usual. Usman was beaten by it. The ball goes straight to the keeper.
Another flick, this time from UK to end the over. 5 runs off this one. 76 needed in 84 now.
On the middle stump line, worked away to deep square leg for a single.
Short of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to cover.
Short of a length outside off, cut away by the southpaw for a single to deep point.
On a length and guided to deep point for a single by Finch.
Khawaja has been struck on the thigh-pad. They pick up a single. The Umpire signals Leg Bye.
Usman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to short third man.
Bowls a full ball, Finch dances down the track and hits it straight back past the bowler. The fielder at long off cuts it. One run added to the total.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another full ball, Usman flicks it again but this time the ball goes past the mid-wicket fielder and the fielder in the deep cuts it off. One run taken.
Full ball on middle, Usman flicks it to mid-wicket.
Guided down to third man to end the over. No trouble at all.
FOUR! Bouncer on off and Khawaja stands tall and pulls it over fine leg for a boundary. Great shot and good control on it.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side by Abbas and UK cannot get bat on it. Signaled wide by the umpire.
Khawaja charges down the wicket but Abbas bowls it short on the middle stump line. Usman ducks under the ball and lets it go.

Tapped down towards mid-wicket for a single by Finch. No pressure at all on the batsmen. The umpire signals it as leg bye though, must have missed the bat. Yes, the replays say the ball went really close to the bat but had no willow on it.
Flicked away to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and pushed back down the ground for a single by Finch. Brings back Khawaja on strike.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.

FOUR! OVERTHROWS! Unnecessary this from the fielder as Pakistan are already wicket-less and conceding runs like this will make the situation even worse. Bowls it full to Finch who drives it straight to cover and thinks off a run. He takes a couple of steps forward and Umar Akmal at cover has a shy at the stumps and misses to hit. The ball goes to the boundary as overthrows.
Leg spinner on the pads, Khawaja flicks it on the leg side and takes a run.
Goes for the reverse sweep again but gets hit on the pads this time.
Usman goes for the reverse sweep but hits it straight to the gully fielder.
Bowls a leg cutter down the leg side, Finch sweeps it fine on the leg side for a single.
Yasir Shah is back into the attack.

Drinks break! The Pakistan bowling has been toothless so far and Aussie openers have continued making merry. The skipper has reached his second ODI ton on the trot and Usman Khawaja looks really comfortable too. Does not look like anything else than 2-0 on the cards here.
Bowls it on the pads this time, Finch flicks it to mid-wicket. Australia need 100 runs off 108 balls.
Length ball outside off, Finch punches it off the back foot to the off side for a single.
Full ball on middle, Usman flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Strays on the pads, Finch looks to clip it but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball goes to square leg and they take a single.
Length ball on off, Finch drives it straight to cover.
Short ball outside off, Usman guides it to third man for an easy single.
A short ball on middle, AF stands tall and defends that on his toes.

That is a two and that is the hundred! Finch's 13th ODI ton! Consecutive tons for the Aussie skipper! A length ball on middle, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for two runs to get to the landmark. Brilliant batting this, for all the flak he got for him being out of form recently, he is responding beautifully with the bat.
Fuller this time, Khawaja punches it to covers for a single.
Onto 99 now! Hasnain bowls it on the pads, Finch flicks it to square leg for a single.
Full ball outside off, Finch punches it to point.
Usman punches it off the back foot to the point region for a single.
Starts from round the wicket with a length ball pitching on leg and going down with the angle. Wide signaled.
On middle stump and a good length, flicked away by UK to deep square leg for a run. He keeps strike. 110 in 120 needed now.
Driven to deep cover with awesome timing. Single taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. Need many more dots here do Pakistan.
Flicked off the pads by Finch to deep fine leg, a good stop by the fielder from deep square leg moving to his right. Two runs saved by him for the team.
Fuller in length this time on middle and leg, defensively pushed back by Finch.
Flicked away to deep square leg for a single by Khawaja.
Mohammad Abbas is brought back on.
Full ball outside off, Finch opens the bat face and guides it to third man where Imad Wasim does well to stop the ball from going into the fence. Two runs saved for his side. 8 runs from the over.
Tad shorter this time, Usman flicks it to mid-wicket and changes strikes.
Bowls it fuller this time. Finch punches it off the back foot to mid off for a single.
FOUR! Into the 90s now! Short ball on middle, Finch rocks back and pulls it to backward square leg. The fielder in the deep gets a hand to it but does not stop it. Four signaled.
Length ball on off, Finch punches it to point.
Full ball on off, Finch punches it off the back foot to the off side. Hasnain does well to collect the ball and stop them from taking a single.
Another dot to end the over but the Aussies are well on top here. Pushed to mid off by Khawaja. 123 runs needed in 132 balls now.
Length ball outside off, patted towards mid-wicket by Khawaja.
Short on middle, Finch stands tall and pulls it away to deep square leg for a run.
Worked down the leg side for a single by UK.

Good work in the deep! A length ball from around the wicket on top of off, Khawaja flicks it away through square leg for a couple of runs as Shaan Masood in the deep does really well to stop that one.
Outside off on a length, cut away to third man for a single by Finch.
Bowls a short pacey ball to Usman to end the over. Usman goes on the back foot and ducks it. It was just above the shoulders if Usman would have stood tall.
Changes length and bowls it full, Finch drives it to mid off for a single. Gets a run after four dots.
Tests Finch with a short ball this time. Bowls it quick and too short, Finch goes for the pull but the ball goes past his ears. He was not ready for that beamer.
Bowls it fuller this time, tailing in. Finch goes on the back foot and brings his bat down at the right time.
Another length ball on off, Finch punches it back to the bowler.
Starts off his new spell with a length ball outside off, Finch plays it to point.
Mohammad Hasnain is back on, a forced change maybe. Pakistan desperately need wickets.
Punched off the back foot towards cover by the southpaw to end the over.
Short outside off, defended from the crease by Usman.
Khawaja has nudged the ball fine down the leg side towards deep backward square leg. Good effort by Shaan Masood to save a certain boundary. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.

Would have been close had Akmal hit! A length ball outside off, Khawaja hits it to point and looks for a single. Finch is sent back by UK and has to stretch to reach the crease in time but the ball misses the stumps anyways on the throw at the bowler's end. 50-50 that.
Outside off, Khawaja looks to run it down to third man but fails to put bat on ball.

Around the wicket, Khawaja runs it down fine on the leg side as the ball was on his pads. Yasir makes a good attempt there and somehow manages to keep the ball inside the rope. Saves 2 runs for his team. Lots of replays there but it is confirmed he made a good save there.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up on the pads, Usman drives it to mid on for a single.
Prods forward and keeps it out.

FOUR! PULLED HARD! Bowls a short one on middle, Usman pulls it hard through the square leg region and it races into the fence. 150 stand up between the two openers. Australia are cruising through the chase.
Shorter in length this time, defended off the back foot.
Tossed up outside off, Usman drives it covers.
Another single to end the over. Khawaja cuts it away to deep point for a run. All too easy so far.
Punched off the back foot to deep cover for a single by the AUS skipper.
Mistimed this one by Khawaja for a single to the right of mid on. The bowler even got a hand on it to make it even slower.
Short and outside off, Khawaja cuts it away in front of cover and picks up a couple of runs. That is good running!
Length ball at the pads, flicked away to deep backward square leg for a run.
Single down to third man off the first ball as Khawaja runs this length ball outside off down there.
Faheem Ashraf is back on.
Floated on middle, defended off the back foot.
Bowls it on the pads, Usman flicks it to the on side. A run taken.
Floated on middle, Finch works it to square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven through the covers and one run scored.
Finch plays it with soft hands to the on side and scampers through for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Khawaja flicks it to mid on and rotates the strike.
SIX! Smashes this one over long on. A flatter ball on middle and Aaron goes full throttle. He picks it and deposits it into the stands at long on. He is making it look really easy.
Defended back to the bowler on the front foot by Finch.
Whipped away by Khawaja to deep mid-wicket for a single. That brings up his 50! His eigth in ODI cricket. Also, his 4th 50-plus score in the last 5 innings. In top form!
Pushed away to deep cover for a single by the Aussie skipper.
Bowled wide outside off, guided to short third man off the back foot by Finch.
FOUR! Finch wants to finish the quickly it looks like. An arm ball full outside off and Aaron smashes this from there through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Wide! Bowls this one down the leg side and is penalised by the umpire.
Imad Wasim is back into the attack.
Floated ball on off, Finch punches it off the back foot to the on side. One run added to the total.
Goes down the track to this full ball and plays it back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Bowls it on the pads, Finch works it to short fine leg.
Fuller on off, Usman drives it to mid on for a single.
Flighted ball outside off and spinning in, Usman pokes at it but gets beaten. Lucky that it did not take the outside edge of the bat.
SIX! The calmness does not last for long! Fuller on middle and Finch comes ahead and slogs it over deep mid-wicket for another huge one. Great batting! The Aussies are now going at 6 RPO.
Flatter one on middle, calm prevails now and AF comes ahead and dead-bats this.
SIX! First four, now six! Yasir goes fuller this time with a bit of air. Finch accepts the offer and lofts the ball way over long on for a maximum. Huge!
FOUR! Short outside off, nothing ball actually. Finch smashes this one off the back foot and to deep cover for a boundary.
Slower this time through the air and on the pads, Khawaja looks to sweep it. Goes aerially for a bit but there is no fielder there. Single taken to deep backward square leg.
Flatter one outside off, Khawaja pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Bowls it on the pads, Finch flicks it to the on side.
Tossed up on off, Usman has pushed it to the cover region for a single.
Bowls it shorter this time, Usman looks to flick but his hit on the thigh pad and the ball rolls to the keeper.
Driven towards the mid-off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Fifty for Finch! 100 run partnership for Australia between Finch and Khawaja! Tossed up ball on middle, Finch puts on his skates and dances down to loft it straight over the bowlers head. The ball goes one bounce into the fence.
Flighted delivery on off, defended watchfully.
Haris Sohail is into the attack now.
Flighted on middle, Finch has punched it to mid on. One run taken.
The batsman has driven it through mid-on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, Finch punches it to mid off for a single.
Bowls it on the legs to Usman who flicks it to the on side and takes off for a run.
Another length ball on off, driven through the covers for a single.
Bowls a leg cutter on off, defended off the back foot.

Drinks break! The Australians have had smooth sailing here. Aaron Finch and Usman Khawaja are batting with ease and there seem to be no demons in the wicket. Pakistan, on the other hand, desperately need a breakthrough to lift some dropping shoulders. Maybe this break can help them regroup and concentrate on the plans.

Pacy again on a short length, 144 kph! Khawaja looks to pull but does not connect the ball well. The ball lobs of his arm guard and lands near the surface. 11 runs off the over, another good one for the Aussies.
Shorter length ball on middle, pulled away to deep fine leg for a single by AF. Smart batting this, a single after a boundary.
FOUR! Fuller outside off, Finch drives it back down the ground past mid on. No stopping these. Great shot from the Aussie skipper.
On the pads, worked down to fine leg for a single by Khawaja.
Slower bouncer on middle and leg, Finch looks to pull it but fails to do so. The keeper also does not collect it and hence a bye is taken.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Finch this. A fuller length ball on middle, Aaron flicks it away through the vacant mid-wicket region for a boundary. He would not mind this kind of length.
Googly to end the over. Pitches it short and on off, Khawaja goes on the back foot to defend it but the ball goes past his outside edge and straight to the keeper.
Floated on middle, Finch punches it to mid on and takes a single.
Usman has flicked the ball off his pads to the on side. One run added to the total.
Tossed up on off, Finch has punched it off the back foot to the covers for a single.
Goes on the front foot to defend it but gets it of the outside edge to point.

SIX! MAXIMUM! Starts off wih a full ball turning in from the leg stump line but Finch clubs it straight down the ground over long on for a biggie. When he hits, he hits them big. First six of the innings.
Shorter length outside off, defended off the back foot towards the cover fielder.
Pacy bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it as he ducks under the ball.
On a length outside off, Finch cuts the ball through point for a single. He must be relieved to be off strike.
This time Finch connects his pull and it goes all along the ground to square leg.
Ouch! This is pacy from Hasnain. 144 clicks, a length ball on middle, Finch looks to pull but the ball is too quick for him and he gets hit on the belly region. He is okay though.
On the thigh pad, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single by Khawaja. Good rotation of the strike this.
Khawaja charges down the wicket and plays it to the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tad fuller this time, Finch punches it off the back foot to the off side for a single.
Bowls a floated leg spinner on off, Usman flicks it to the on side for a single.
Shorter in length outside off, defended off the back foot.
Tad shorter this time, driven through the covers for a single.
Yasir starts off with a leg cutter on middle and fuller in length, Finch tries to defend but it takes the outer half of the bat to the point region.
Yasir Shah into the attack.
Better from Hasnain, on a length outside off at 143 clicks. Khawaja defends it back towards the bowler.
Short of a length on middle, Finch takes his eyes off the ball as he pulls it. It goes towards deep square leg on a few bounces. Single taken.
FOUR! Straying on the pads and Finch just uses the pace to glance it really fine on the leg side for a boundary. Australia doing this easily as of now.
Length outside off, turned down to third man for a single by Khawaja.

Finch takes off his helmet, has a look at it and takes some time to compose himself. Looks rattled but okay to continue. The padding inside the helmet is being changed and hence, there is a slight stoppage in play.
Bouncer! Quick one at 147 clicks almost! Finch looks to pull but the ball is too quick for him. The ball goes off the glove and then off the helmet and towards deep fine leg for a run.
Short of a length on middle, Khawaja whips it away for a single to deep square leg.
Ends it with a full ball on off, defended firmly by Finch.
Tad shorter outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
FOUR! DRIVEN! Finch makes room on this one and drives it uppishly over covers for a one bounce four. The shuffle helped him to open his hands and play this ball with perfection.
Full ball on the pads, defended off the back foot towards mid on.
Usman opens the bat face to this length ball and guides it to third man for a run.
Full ball on middle, driven towards the mid-on region.
Usman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads. They pick up a single.
Shorter this time outside off, Usman opens the bat face and guides it to third man for a single.
Fuller this time on the pads, Finch moves across and drives it to covers for a single.
Bowls it on a back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to the point region for a single.
Starts off with a pacey short ball, Khawaja ducks to it and lets it go to the keeper. Khawaja was surprised by the pace on that one.
Mohammad Hasnain to bowl now at the start of the second Powerplay. 4 players can be outside the circle for the fielding team now till the 40th over.
Pushed towards cover off the back foot by Finch to end the 10th over.
Fuller outside off, Finch hits it aerially towards mid off. The fielder at mid off, Wasim runs to his left and tries to catch the ball but it lands just short of him. Lucky for the Aussie skipper.
On a length and fired at the thigh pad, flicked towards square leg for a single by UK.
Dropped on to the off side by Khawaja and he shouts a loud NO to send Finch back to the crease as he was looking for a tight single.
Straying down on the pads this time, Aaron Finch looks to flick it but misses. The ball rolls off his pads to the leg side for a leg bye.
On a length outside off, punched off the back foot to extra cover by Finch.

FOUR! PERFECTION! Khawaja goes on the front foot to this full ball ball and caresses it through the covers for a boundary. The timing was so perfect that the cover fielder couldn't reach there even with a diving effort. It looked like he was unable to find the ball, maybe due to bad light. After giving just 1 run in his first two overs, Imad conceded 12 runs in his third over and now he again concedes 12 in his fifth over.
Fuller ball on off, driven off the back foot to the covers for a single.
Tossed up on off, driven to mid on for a single.
Strays on the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! PUNCHED! Finch reads the line of this flighted ball outside off. He rocks back and cuts it hard through point for a boundary.
Tossed up ball on the pads, flicked on the on side for a single.
Length ball outside off, Finch drives it to cover.
Changes the line and bowls it fuller, Finch gets his bat down at the right time and plays it back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller ball on off, punched off the back foot to point.
Bowls this one outside off, Usman opens the bat face and guides it to third man for a single.
Starts his spell with a length ball on off, Khawaja plays it to point.
Faheem Ashraf is into the attack now.
Another front foot defense from the skipper to end a good over from Wasim. Good comeback after going for plenty in his previous.
Pushed in quicker once more, Aaron comes ahead and defends with a straight bat.
A quicker one darted in on middle and leg, Khawaja drives it back down the ground to long on for a single.
A flatter ball outside off, defended onto the surface by Usman coming ahead.
Flatter outside off, pushed back towards mid off by the southpaw.
Flatter one on middle, Finch works it towards square leg and picks up a really quick single.
Ends the over with a length ball outside off, defended firmly.
FOUR! Bowls it pitching on middle and angling in, Usman plays it off his pads and the ball goes past the keeper to the fine leg region for a boundary.
Full on off, driven to covers.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads.
Leg bye! Bowls it on a back of a length, Finch tries flicking it but gets beaten and ball hits him on the thighs and goes to point. One run taken.
Full ball on middle, punched to mid on for a single.
On the pads and worked on the leg side for a single by UK and he keeps strike. 12 runs off this over.
FOUR! Two in two! Khawaja creams this flatter one outside off through the covers and gets a boundary to his name. Beautiful and smart batting this, using the pace on the ball.
FOUR! Straying on the pads of Usman this time, Khawaja glances it really fine through the leg side and finds the fence this time. The first boundary of Wasim's bowling tonight.
Bowled on the pads, Finch runs it fine on the leg side. Hasnain from short fine leg gives chase and stops the ball just inside the rope. 3 runs taken.
Outside off on a slower pace, Finch pushes it towards the left of the bowler where the extra cover fielder runs and prevents any runs.
Flatter on middle, pushed back to the right of the bowler where Wasim moves and makes a good stop.
1000 ODI runs for Usman Khawaja! Reaches there by playing a flick off his pads to a full ball angling into him. The ball goes to deep backward square leg and they take a brace.
Another length ball outside off, Khawaja looks to drive but the bat rolls in his hands and the ball takes the inside half and goes to the mid-wicket fielder.
Back of a length ball on off, defended firmly.
Bowls it outside off, Usman plays down the wrong line.
Tad fuller and angling in to the left-hander, Usman flicks it to mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, driven to the left of mid off. One run taken.
Flatter one on middle, Finch prods forward defensively but gets an inside edge towards square leg for a single.
A flatter one on middle, defensively pushed towards mid-wicket by the Aussie skipper.
Straying on the pads, Finch runs it fine on the leg side but a leg slip in place stops the ball diving to his right.
Outside off and quick, Finch looks for an expansive drive but the ball goes off the inside edge to the short fine leg fielder.
Another flat one on middle, defended back to the bowler with a straight bat.
Flatter one outside off, pushed back to the bowler by Finch.
Bowls it short this time, Khawaja blocks it off his back foot.

FOUR! EXCELLENT! Khawaja was well set for this full ball outside off. Reads the line and drives it handsomely through the gap at covers. Once it went past them, there was no stopping it. The ball raced away to the fence.
FOUR! WRISTY! Khawaja is off the mark with a boundary! Abbas strays on the pads to Khawaja who plays a wristy flick to the on side. The ball races past the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence.
Bowls it on the pads this time, Finch goes back and plays it to mid on and goes for the run. Direct hit at the non-striker's end but Finch was well in. Finch and Australia are underway.
Another full ball, driven straight to extra cover.
Full length delivery outside off, Finch punches it cover-point.
Mohammad Abbas to bowl with the other new ball.
Full ball driven to mid off. Maiden over to begin the proceedings.
Bowls it quicker, Khawaja plays at it but misses the line.
Flighted on off, Usman drives it mid off.
Fuller this time, driven hard but straight to the fielder at cover.
A slip comes in place now.
Similar line, left alone.
Starts off the innings with a tossed up ball outside off, Usman prods forward and opens the bat face but the ball goes past his edge and into the keeper's gloves.
We are back for the chase! 285 to win, Aaron Finch and Usman Khawaja will be the two openers for Australia. Imad Wasim with the first new ball for Pakistan. Let's play!
